verses.en: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.pt: Portanto, agora nenhuma condenação há para os que estão em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause those who are in Christ Jesus will not be judged as sinners.

verses.en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.pt: Porque a lei do Espírito da vida, em Cristo Jesus, te livrou da lei do pecado e da morte.
verses.en_web: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
verses.en_bbe: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.

verses.en: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.pt: Porquanto o que era impossível à lei, visto que se achava fraca pela carne, Deus enviando o seu próprio Filho em semelhança da carne do pecado, e por causa do pecado, na carne condenou o pecado.
verses.en_web: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;
verses.en_bbe: For what the law was not able to do because it was feeble through the flesh, God, sending his Son in the image of the evil flesh, and as an offering for sin, gave his decision against sin in the flesh:

verses.en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.pt: para que a justa exigência da lei se cumprisse em nós, que não andamos segundo a carne, mas segundo o Espírito.
verses.en_web: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: So that what was ordered by the law might be done in us, who are living, not in the way of the flesh, but in the way of the Spirit.

verses.en: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.pt: Pois os que são segundo a carne inclinam-se para as coisas da carne; mas os que são segundo o Espírito para as coisas do Espírito.
verses.en_web: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: For those who are living in the way of the flesh give their minds to the things of the flesh, but those who go in the way of the Spirit, to the things of the Spirit.

verses.en: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.pt: Porque a inclinação da carne é morte; mas a inclinação do Espírito é vida e paz.
verses.en_web: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
verses.en_bbe: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace:

verses.en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
verses.pt: Porquanto a inclinação da carne é inimizade contra Deus, pois não é sujeita à lei de Deus, nem em verdade o pode ser;
verses.en_web: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
verses.en_bbe: Because the mind of the flesh is opposite to God; it is not under the law of God, and is not able to be:

verses.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.pt: e os que estão na carne não podem agradar a Deus.
verses.en_web: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
verses.en_bbe: So that those who are in the flesh are not able to give pleasure to God.

verses.en: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.pt: Vós, porém, não estais na carne, mas no Espírito, se é que o Espírito de Deus habita em vós. Mas, se alguém não tem o Espírito de Cristo, esse tal não é dele.
verses.en_web: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
verses.en_bbe: You are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if the Spirit of God is in you. But if any man has not the Spirit of Christ he is not one of his.

verses.en: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.pt: Ora, se Cristo está em vós, o corpo, na verdade, está morto por causa do pecado, mas o espírito vive por causa da justiça.
verses.en_web: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

verses.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.pt: E, se o Espírito daquele que dos mortos ressuscitou a Jesus habita em vós, aquele que dos mortos ressuscitou a Cristo Jesus há de vivificar também os vossos corpos mortais, pelo seu Espírito que em vós habita.
verses.en_web: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
verses.en_bbe: But if the Spirit of him who made Jesus come again from the dead is in you, he who made Christ Jesus come again from the dead will in the same way, through his Spirit which is in you, give life to your bodies which now are under the power of death.

verses.en: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.pt: Portanto, irmãos, somos devedores, não à carne para vivermos segundo a carne;
verses.en_web: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.en_bbe: So then, my brothers, we are in debt, not to the flesh to be living in the way of the flesh:

verses.en: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.pt: porque se viverdes segundo a carne, haveis de morrer; mas, se pelo Espírito mortificardes as obras do corpo, vivereis.
verses.en_web: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
verses.en_bbe: For if you go in the way of the flesh, death will come on you; but if by the Spirit you put to death the works of the body, you will have life.

verses.en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.pt: Pois todos os que são guiados pelo Espírito de Deus, esses são filhos de Deus.
verses.en_web: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
verses.en_bbe: And all those who are guided by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

verses.en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.pt: Porque não recebestes o espírito de escravidão, para outra vez estardes com temor, mas recebestes o espírito de adoção, pelo qual clamamos: Aba, Pai!
verses.en_web: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
verses.en_bbe: For you did not get the spirit of servants again to put you in fear, but the spirit of sons was given to you, by which we say, Abba, Father.

verses.en: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.pt: O Espírito mesmo testifica com o nosso espírito que somos filhos de Deus;
verses.en_web: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
verses.en_bbe: The Spirit is witness with our spirit that we are children of God:

verses.en: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.pt: e, se filhos, também herdeiros, herdeiros de Deus e co-herdeiros de Cristo; se é certo que com ele padecemos, para que também com ele sejamos glorificados.
verses.en_web: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
verses.en_bbe: And if we are children, we have a right to a part in the heritage; a part in the things of God, together with Christ; so that if we have a part in his pain, we will in the same way have a part in his glory.

verses.en: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.pt: Pois tenho para mim que as aflições deste tempo presente não se podem comparar com a glória que em nós há de ser revelada.
verses.en_web: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
verses.en_bbe: I am of the opinion that there is no comparison between the pain of this present time and the glory which we will see in the future.

verses.en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.pt: Porque a criação aguarda com ardente expectativa a revelação dos filhos de Deus.
verses.en_web: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
verses.en_bbe: For the strong desire of every living thing is waiting for the revelation of the sons of God.

verses.en: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
verses.pt: Porquanto a criação ficou sujeita à vaidade, não por sua vontade, mas por causa daquele que a sujeitou,
verses.en_web: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
verses.en_bbe: For every living thing was put under the power of change, not by its desire, but by him who made it so, in hope

verses.en: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.pt: na esperança de que também a própria criação há de ser liberta do cativeiro da corrupção, para a liberdade da glória dos filhos de Deus.
verses.en_web: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
verses.en_bbe: That all living things will be made free from the power of death and will have a part with the free children of God in glory.

verses.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.pt: Porque sabemos que toda a criação, conjuntamente, geme e está com dores de parto até agora;
verses.en_web: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
verses.en_bbe: For we are conscious that all living things are weeping and sorrowing in pain together till now.

verses.en: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
verses.pt: e não só ela, mas até nós, que temos as primícias do Espírito, também gememos em nós mesmos, aguardando a nossa adoração, a saber, a redenção do nosso corpo.
verses.en_web: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
verses.en_bbe: And not only so, but we who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we have sorrow in our minds, waiting for the time when we will take our place as sons, that is, the salvation of our bodies.

verses.en: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.pt: Porque na esperança fomos salvos. Ora, a esperança que se vê não é esperança; pois o que alguém vê, como o espera?
verses.en_web: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
verses.en_bbe: For our salvation is by hope: but hope which is seen is not hope: for who is hoping for what he sees?

verses.en: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
verses.pt: Mas, se esperamos o que não vemos, com paciência o aguardamos.
verses.en_web: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
verses.en_bbe: But if we have hope for that which we see not, then we will be able to go on waiting for it.

verses.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.pt: Do mesmo modo também o Espírito nos ajuda na fraqueza; porque não sabemos o que havemos de pedir como convém, mas o Espírito mesmo intercede por nós com gemidos inexprimíveis.
verses.en_web: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
verses.en_bbe: And in the same way the Spirit is a help to our feeble hearts: for we are not able to make prayer to God in the right way; but the Spirit puts our desires into words which are not in our power to say;

verses.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.pt: E aquele que esquadrinha os corações sabe qual é a intenção do Espírito: que ele, segundo a vontade de Deus, intercede pelos santos.
verses.en_web: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
verses.en_bbe: And he who is the searcher of hearts has knowledge of the mind of the Spirit, because he is making prayers for the saints in agreement with the mind of God.

verses.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.pt: E sabemos que todas as coisas concorrem para o bem daqueles que amam a Deus, daqueles que são chamados segundo o seu propósito.
verses.en_web: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
verses.en_bbe: And we are conscious that all things are working together for good to those who have love for God, and have been marked out by his purpose.

verses.en: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.pt: Porque os que dantes conheceu, também os predestinou para serem conformes à imagem de seu Filho, a fim de que ele seja o primogênito entre muitos irmãos;
verses.en_web: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Because those of whom he had knowledge before they came into existence, were marked out by him to be made like his Son, so that he might be the first among a band of brothers:

verses.en: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.pt: e aos que predestinou, a estes também chamou; e aos que chamou, a estes também justificou; e aos que justificou, a estes também glorificou.
verses.en_web: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
verses.en_bbe: And those who were marked out by him were named; and those who were named were given righteousness; and to those to whom he gave righteousness, in the same way he gave glory.

verses.en: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.pt: Que diremos, pois, a estas coisas? Se Deus é por nós, quem será contra nós?
verses.en_web: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
verses.en_bbe: What may we say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?

verses.en: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.pt: Aquele que nem mesmo a seu próprio Filho poupou, antes o entregou por todos nós, como não nos dará também com ele todas as coisas?
verses.en_web: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
verses.en_bbe: He who did not keep back his only Son, but gave him up for us all, will he not with him freely give us all things?

verses.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God’s elect? It is God that justifieth.
verses.pt: Quem intentará acusação contra os escolhidos de Deus? É Deus quem os justifica;
verses.en_web: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
verses.en_bbe: Who will say anything against the saints of God? It is God who makes us clear from evil;

verses.en: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.pt: Quem os condenará? Cristo Jesus é quem morreu, ou antes quem ressurgiu dentre os mortos, o qual está à direita de Deus, e também intercede por nós;
verses.en_web: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
verses.en_bbe: Who will give a decision against us? It is Christ Jesus who not only was put to death, but came again from the dead, who is now at the right hand of God, taking our part.

verses.en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.pt: quem nos separará do amor de Cristo? a tribulação, ou a angústia, ou a perseguição, ou a fome, ou a nudez, ou o perigo, ou a espada?
verses.en_web: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.en_bbe: Who will come between us and the love of Christ? Will trouble, or pain, or cruel acts, or the need of food or of clothing, or danger, or the sword?

verses.en: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.pt: Como está escrito: Por amor de ti somos entregues à morte o dia todo; fomos considerados como ovelhas para o matadouro.
verses.en_web: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
verses.en_bbe: As it is said in the holy Writings, Because of you we are put to death every day; we are like sheep ready for destruction.

verses.en: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.pt: Mas em todas estas coisas somos mais que vencedores, por aquele que nos amou.
verses.en_web: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
verses.en_bbe: But we are able to overcome all these things and more through his love.

verses.en: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.pt: Porque estou certo de que, nem a morte, nem a vida, nem anjos, nem principados, nem coisas presentes, nem futuras, nem potestades,
verses.en_web: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
verses.en_bbe: For I am certain that not death, or life, or angels, or rulers, or things present, or things to come, or powers,

verses.en: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.pt: nem a altura, nem a profundidade, nem qualquer outra criatura nos poderá separar do amor de Deus, que está em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.
verses.en_web: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Or things on high, or things under the earth, or anything which is made, will be able to come between us and the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
